objective.text: Verify an existing password with the configured hasher rather than comparing new salted hashes.

difficulty.rationale: Verify against the stored hash instead of comparing two independently salted outputs.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A custom login check compares Hash::make($submitted) === $storedHash and rejects the correct password. The stored hash uses the configured algorithm. Which operation checks the credential correctly?

options.rationale: Constant-time string comparison does not remove the different random salts from newly generated hashes.
options.misconception: Constant-time string comparison does not remove the different random salts from newly generated hashes.

options.rationale: A password hash is not a reversible encrypted value.
options.misconception: A password hash is not a reversible encrypted value.

options.rationale: check verifies the plaintext against the algorithm, salt and cost encoded in the stored hash.
needsRehash examines hashing parameters, not whether the submitted password is correct.
options.misconception: needsRehash examines hashing parameters, not whether the submitted password is correct.
